title: WebP Screenshots
description: Saves screenshots as a WebP instead of PNG to save on storage.
body:
# WebP Screenshots
[![modrinth](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/modrinth_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/webpscreenshots)
[![codeberg](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/codeberg_vector.svg)](https://codeberg.org/Maganoos/webpscreenshots)

Have you ever run out of storage or cut close to it because of the obscene amount of screenshots you take? This mod fixes that!
This mod compresses your screenshots and converts them to the [WebP](https://chromium.googlesource.com/webm/libwebp) format to reduce filesize.
